repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire after 29 seconds (29 ticks) instead of the required 30 seconds. Additionally, the 1000 ms period cannot detect a condition drop and recovery between iterations, violating the sustain requirement.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100 ms to match the sustain grid. Updated the threshold to 301 (30 seconds / 100 ms + 1) to ensure the action fires exactly at the 30-second mark when the condition has been sustained for the full duration.
